title: Quick toggles in the editor menu
summary: A small arrow beside Settings in the editor's X menu opens three one-click toggles, so you can switch common editor options without leaving the page you're on.
highlights: Mirror: pause mirroring for every template at once. Each template keeps its own mirror axes for when you turn it back on.
Menus: hide or show the floating editor menus; turning them back on returns to the mode you had.
Frame: show or hide the carriage around Contents builds, so you can see and reach your build from every side. Also in Settings.
